item.title: Chips Act 2.0, Part 2: From Brussels to the Bench: What Chips Act 2.0 Means for Engineers
item.summary: For engineers, Chips Act 2.0 is less about grand rhetoric and more about where the jobs, tools, and career ladders are likely to appear. The short version is this: Europe is trying to thicken the whole engineering pipeline, not only fab headcount.
